title: security: rbac v2 KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Maya Patel
description: This PR hardens RBAC v2 controls around KMS key residency and region-pinning and improves audit logging for all cross-region KMS operations. Motivation: several customer compliance reviews and internal security audits surfaced gaps in how RBAC policies were evaluated when customers configured KMS region constraints and how those decisions were surfaced in audit logs (ENG-1824, SEC-39). Changes are designed to be backwards-compatible by default but enforceable via a new cluster-wide enforcement flag. Checklist: - [x] RBAC policy schema extension for kms.residency constraint - [x] Enforce/evaluate pinning at policy evaluation time + fallback rules - [x] Add audit log entries for region-evaluation decisions and KMS key selection - [x] Helm values and installer parameter for enforcement mode - [x] Unit + integration tests for policy evaluation and audit entries - [x] Docs + migration notes and Linear/Jira links Notes: - By default the cluster is in audit-mode: policies that would be rejected are logged as audit events but still allowed. Setting spec.security.kmsResidency.enforce = true flips to enforcement mode and will block offending requests. - The PR adds deterministic evaluation precedence for multi-policy matches (explicit resource-level pinning > role-level > organization defaults). - Added explicit deny when a request attempts to decrypt with a KMS key outside allowed regions and enforcement is enabled; when disabled, the behavior is to log the decision and route the request to the nearest allowed key if available. - Updated the KMS client integration to annotate requests with "rbac_policy_eval_id" so that downstream audit logs can correlate evaluation decisions with requests. - Migration: operators should enable enforcement during maintenance windows after rolling out agent-side updates (redwood-private-installer and helm charts updated). Related: Linear ENG-1824, SEC-39; Jira SUP-4123 for a customer-facing incident that triggered this work.

release_notes: Security: RBAC v2 now supports KMS residency (region pinning) constraints. New cluster setting 'spec.security.kmsResidency.enforce' defaults to audit mode; operators should review migration docs before enabling enforcement. Audit logs now include structured events for KMS residency decisions and rbac_policy_eval_id to correlate policy evaluations with requests.
